title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Apply Law in Cases of Disputes over Contracts for Transfer of Land-Use Rights of State-Owned Land Reclaimed for Farming

articles.content_en:
Higher People's Court of Gansu Province:
Your Court's Request for Instructions on How to Apply the Law to the Transfer of the Right to Operate State-Owned Land (Gan Gao Fa [2010] No. 84) has been received. Upon study, we reply as follows:
State-owned land that has been reclaimed and used for farming but has not been placed under collective use by farmers shall not constitute rural land as prescribed in Article 2 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Rural Land Contracting. The transfer of the right to use such land shall not be governed by the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Rural Land Contracting, but shall be regulated by the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Land Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant laws and regulations.
For a contract for the transfer of the right to use state-owned land that has been reclaimed and used for farming, if the contract does not violate the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations, and a party merely requests confirmation that the contract is void on the ground that the transferor has not obtained the certificate of the right to use the land, the People's Court shall not support such request according to law; if a party claims, in accordance with the contract, that the other party shall perform the obligation of applying for the certificate of the right to use the land, the People's Court shall support such claim according to law.
